run_iterative_refinement: run iterative refinement loop that evaluates and improves a pipeline configuration using LLM feedback
create_improvement_prompt: create a prompt for the LLM to improve a pipeline configuration based on evaluation metrics and history
extract_code_block: extract python code from an LLM response by parsing markdown code block markers
format_rich_feedback: format detailed module feedback with correct and incorrect modules plus actionable hints
load_config: load and parse a YAML configuration file for the iterative refinement agent
